name: UI-Redline-bench
description:
UI-Redline-bench
	

This dataset contains the benchmark data for the paper "UI-Redline-bench: 赤入れ指示によるWebUIコード修正ベンチマーク".
The benchmark evaluates the capability of Vision-Language Models (VLMs) to modify Web UI code (HTML/CSS) based on visual "redline" instructions (handwritten or digital) drawn on screenshots.
📄 Paper | 💻 GitHub Repository (Evaluation Code & Runnable Environment)

This Hugging Face dataset contains only the images and the corresponding metadata.… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/future-architect/UI-Redline-bench.
evaluation_method: edit exact_match and functional correctness / task_success_rate (compare generated HTML/CSS edits to target and evaluate rendered/behavioral equivalence)
reputation: New dataset hosted on Hugging Face targeted at researchers on vision–language models for UI code editing; limited adoption so far.
